title.narrative: Enhance National and Local Capacities to Combat TIP

description.narrative: To build and strengthen the government along with local organizations to respond to victims of trafficking. The project will build government and local capacity to respond to TIP victims in BiH through improved protection, prevention, and prosecution, and will be implemented across 30 BiH local municipalities. WV plans to improve provision of protection services that lead to victims and survivors achieving sustainable livelihoods and community and family resilience; help advance implementation of the multi-disciplinary national referral mechanism (NRM); and raise awareness on human trafficking and risk factors for first responders, medical professionals, teachers, and other relevant community members.

title.narrative: U.S. Department of State: Nonproliferation Assistance Programs - Nonproliferation and Disarmament Fund

title.narrative: Enhancing Counter Trafficking in Crisis in the Western Balkans

description.narrative: This project will increase capacity for proactive screening, victim identification, and services among vulnerable populations. The International Organization for Migration will conduct trainings for civil society and front-line officials to enhance TIP victim screening and identification. The project will provide services for victims and conduct public awareness campaigns among refugee and migrant populations to reduce vulnerability to TIP, including long-term vulnerability beyond initial arrival. This regional project also will include regional coordination meetings to improve cross-border coordination and referrals.
